svg.text: Report potholes, overflowing waste, broken streetlights and other local
issues. Neighbours help verify them. Ward teams can show what happens next.
Designed for clear reporting, shared visibility and accountable follow-through.
Reports are ranked by a transparent priority score, not hidden decision-making.
Confirm a report only when you have personally observed the issue.
A deep pothole is forcing two-wheelers to swerve into moving traffic.
Location: Knowledge Park III, near Gate 2
Waste is spreading onto the footpath near the market entrance.
The streetlight beside the bus stop is not working after dark.
Water remains on the road because the drain appears blocked.
Give the issue a clear title, choose its category and severity,
and add a location. A precise location helps group repeat reports.
Do not include personal information, faces or vehicle number plates.
e.g. Deep pothole near the market entrance
e.g. Knowledge Park III, near Gate 2
Describe the issue, how long it has been there and who may be affected…
From a local problem to visible progress.
